question: In this video clip, how is the paragliding's location moving in the 3D scene relative to his/her/its starting orientation and location?

final_answer.text: C: Moving backward-right. The displacement projected onto the paraglider's own facing axis was -0.0055 (backward) against 0.1034 lateral (right) and -0.0141 vertical (math_1), so the motion is primarily rightward relative to its own orientation.
final_answer.limitations: The facing axis was derived from two grounded torso points in frame 0 and assumed constant; if the paraglider turned during the clip the projection uses only the starting orientation.
